summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sales Incentive Rules and Multipliers feature. All backend APIs pass (17/17 tests). Frontend features are fully functional including Client Type/Lead Source dropdowns with Arabic labels, Incentive Breakdown panel with deal size badge, Sales Rep/Manager deductions in Profitability Dashboard, and Admin Incentive Rules page with editable multipliers.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/incentive-rules returns all rules with deal_size, role, base_percent, max_cap
✅ Backend: Rules exist for deal sizes: tiny, standard, big, mega
✅ Backend: GET /api/incentive-multipliers returns existing_customer_multiplier=0.9 and referral_multiplier=0.5
✅ Backend: POST /api/calculate/simple with client_type='new' and lead_source='direct' uses multiplier=1.0
✅ Backend: POST /api/calculate/simple with client_type='existing' applies 0.9 multiplier
✅ Backend: POST /api/calculate/simple with lead_source='referral' applies 0.5 multiplier
✅ Backend: Combined existing+referral applies 0.45 multiplier (0.9 × 0.5)
✅ Backend: Deal size auto-detection based on estimated selling price
✅ Backend: Incentive breakdown has sales_rep and sales_manager with base_percent, adjusted_percent, value, capped_value, cap
✅ Backend: Total incentive equals sum of capped values
✅ Backend: cap_applied flag present in incentive breakdown
✅ Backend: Contribution Margin = Selling Price - COGS - Total Incentive
✅ Backend: PUT /api/incentive-multipliers requires admin auth (returns 401 without)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/incentive-multipliers works with admin auth
✅ Backend: GET /api/deal-size-ranges returns range configuration
✅ Frontend: Calculator page loads with Sales Incentive Settings section
✅ Frontend: Client Type dropdown with Arabic labels (عميل جديد / عميل حالي)
✅ Frontend: Lead Source dropdown with Arabic labels (مباشر / إحالة)
✅ Frontend: Incentive Breakdown panel shows deal size badge (TINY/STANDARD/BIG/MEGA)
✅ Frontend: Incentive Breakdown shows Sales Representative and Sales Manager separately with percentages
✅ Frontend: Multiplier info displayed when < 1 (خصم 10% / خصم 50%)
✅ Frontend: Profitability Dashboard shows Sales Rep and Sales Manager deductions separately
✅ Frontend: Profitability Dashboard shows Total Incentive with percentage
✅ Frontend: Contribution Margin equals Target Margin (30%) when no caps applied
✅ Admin: Incentive Rules page loads with rules grouped by deal size (Tiny/Standard/Big/Mega)
✅ Admin: Each deal size shows Sales Rep and Sales Manager rules with Base % and Cap
✅ Admin: Multipliers section shows existing_customer and referral multipliers
✅ Admin: Can edit and save multipliers (tested changing to 0.85/0.6 and restoring to 0.9/0.5)
✅ Admin: Example calculation updates dynamically (Base% × 0.9 × 0.5 = Base% × 0.45)
seed_data_creation: Incentive rules already seeded via /api/seed-data with: Tiny (5%/2%), Standard (4%/2%), Big (3%/1.5%), Mega (2%/1%). Multipliers: existing_customer=0.9, referral=0.5
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Sales Incentive Rules features are working correctly. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_incentive_rules.py cover all calculation scenarios including multipliers, caps, and contribution margin formula. The formula is: Selling_Price = COGS / (1 - Margin% - Total_Incentive%), then incentives are calculated from final price with caps applied. Deal size ranges: Tiny <200K, Standard 200K-500K, Big 500K-2M, Mega 2M+. Admin panel at /admin/incentive-rules allows editing rules and multipliers.

incentive_rules_api.details: GET /api/incentive-rules returns rules grouped by deal_size (tiny/standard/big/mega) with role (sales_rep/sales_manager), base_percent, max_cap, is_active

incentive_multipliers_api.details: GET /api/incentive-multipliers returns existing_customer_multiplier (0.9) and referral_multiplier (0.5). PUT requires admin auth.

calculate_simple_with_incentives.details: POST /api/calculate/simple accepts client_type (new/existing) and lead_source (direct/referral). Returns incentive_breakdown with sales_rep, sales_manager, total_incentive, deal_size, client_multiplier.

frontend_calculator_incentive_settings.details: Sales Incentive Settings section with Client Type and Lead Source dropdowns. Arabic labels displayed. Incentive Breakdown panel shows deal size badge and per-role breakdown.

frontend_profitability_dashboard.details: Shows Sales Rep and Sales Manager deductions separately under DEDUCTIONS section. Total Incentive with percentage displayed.

admin_incentive_rules_page.details: Rules grouped by deal size cards (Tiny/Standard/Big/Mega). Each shows Sales Rep and Sales Manager with Base % and Cap. Multipliers section with editable inputs and Save button.
